content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert PDR-4012 fired for service=redwood-inference-runtime, symptom=error-rate>5% over 1m, severity=high. Routed to on-call primary @jordan. Runbook: https://go/runbooks/runtime-errors
pagerduty: AUTOMATED MESSAGE: Notification sent to primary: jordan (mobile). Escalation policy: primary -> secondary (after 120s) -> manager (after 300s). Alert details: count=87 errors/min, sample log: 
```
2026-03-15T02:14:07Z ERROR stream: kv cache fail: timeout 5001ms
```
pagerduty: No ACK from primary after 120s. Auto-escalating to secondary: sam.
sam: got it, I'm awake. jumping in :coffee:
jordan (oncall): sorry sleeping through mobile alarm, just saw missed page. ack'ing now. what's the impact?
sam: looks like model runtime returning 500s on seq-len=2048 requests, spike started ~02:12 UTC. hitting one pool (gpu-pool-7).
maria: pulling logs + dashboard, plotting requests by region. EU appears unaffected, US-east has most failures.
tess (manager): I'm getting notifications too — if primary is unresponsive we should follow escalation. can someone try a quick warm-restart of the pool?
alex: trying a rolling restart on gpu-pool-7 now, doing single-host drain -> restart to avoid full outage. command: ```kubectl -n inference rollout restart ds/gpu-pool-7-host-3```
incident-bot: Action recorded: alex initiated restart on host-3 at 02:18 UTC.
sam: host restarted, but errors persisted. KV cache misses still high. I'm going to failover traffic to pool-9 (same model, different AZ) for affected customers. executing runbook step 4 (traffic re-route).
jordan (oncall): please annotate customers with potential degraded latency. I'll start a call with ops.
pagerduty: MANUAL ESCALATION: Manager alerted after secondary ack (tess). Manager page delivered.
tess (manager): on the phone with infra ops now :phone: - working hypothesis: an upgraded kernel patch on pool-7 hosts caused a noisy IO pattern, eviction of cache. rolling back patch might fix.
maria: confirmed unusual IO latency spikes on host-3 and host-5 matching kernel upgrade timestamp 01:50 UTC.
alex: initiated rollback of kernel change on host-3 and host-5, applying safe profile.
incident-bot: PagerDuty note: escalation to manager acknowledged by tess at 02:22 UTC.
sam: after rollback, error-rate back down to baseline ~02:26 UTC. reconnects normalizing.
jordan (oncall): acknowledging recovery. marking incident as mitigated.
tess (manager): good job. need postmortem and action items: 1) prevent auto-patch on inference hosts, 2) add preflight test for IO latency after kernel updates, 3) improve PD escalation SMS to include region.
maria: creating CSAT/impact note: approx 14 active customers experienced 5-20% higher error rates or latency spikes for ~14 minutes; no data loss observed.
sam: opening an internal ticket INF-4317 for rollback + patch gating, assigning to infra team.
jordan (oncall): I'll schedule a brief handoff doc for next oncall and ping ops-reload channel for follow-up.
incident-bot: Incident closed in PagerDuty by sam at 02:30 UTC. Follow-up: Please file postmortem within 72h and tag owners. :memo:
alex: quick note — oncall mute/ack timing overlap caused primary to miss first alarm; maybe we should add multi-channel (sms + call) fallback if mobile DND active.
tess (manager): agree, add as action item. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
